title: Red Curry {p} with {v}
steps: Cook the {s} following the package directions and keep it warm.
Fry the {spice} in a spoonful of oil for a minute, until fragrant, then whisk in the {sauce} and a cup of broth.
Add the {v} and simmer 4 to 5 minutes until tender.
Add the {p} and simmer gently until {doneness}. Serve over the {s}.
tip: Light coconut milk and plenty of vegetables keep the curry lighter without losing flavor.
